text:
Erin: Kicking off CloudCo marketplace onboarding. Goals: private offer setup across AWS/GCP/Azure, trials controlled via private SKUs, and legal-approved telemetry copy. Quick owners?

Kofi: I'll do the private-offer wiring (offer + SKU mapping). Need final product slug and whether trials are redeemable more than once per account.

Mei: I'll run the build & publish pipelines for images. Note: GCP image imports need a signed service account key step. Also we'll produce per-region manifests.

Samantha: Legal: telemetry must be explicit in listing. Provide a short list of event types and confirm no usernames / raw logs are exported. I can draft marketplace-friendly language once confirmed.

Erin: Decisions: trials = single 14-day per account; yes private SKUs. Owners: Kofi = SKUs/offer, Mei = images/manifests, Samantha = EULA telemetry.

Kofi: Product slug = cloudco-enterprise. Trial SKU = cloudco-trial-14d. I'll map to our entitlement system and ensure redemption hook posts to /billing/trial-redeem.

Mei: CI jobs: aws-build-129, gcp-build-130, azure-build-131. Output manifest example (string): "region=us-east-1,ami=ami-0aa111, kms=arn:aws:kms:us-east-1:222:key/fff". We'll store manifests in s3://marketplace-manifests/cloudco/1740001111.json

Samantha: Draft telemetry blurb: "Anonymous usage and crash telemetry are collected to improve service quality; no PII is shared externally." Need list of events: start/stop, api_error, sku_redeem, latency_samples. Confirm?

Erin: Yes include sku_redeem and trial_expiry in anonymous payload. No account-level identifiers in outgoing feed. We'll keep account_id only for internal billing logs.

infra-bot: publisher-portal: CloudCo tenant created. IdP metadata upload pending. Upload URL: https://publisher.redwood.ai/hooks/onboard-123

Kofi: For SSO, CloudCo will use SAML. Contact is marta@cloudco.io. I'll provision a staging role with minimal perms: PublishWrite and AssetList.

Mei: Note on KMS: CloudCo requests to use customer-managed keys in eu-west-1. Our platform supports external KMS ARNs but requires security sign-off. I'll file SEC-1254.

Samantha: I'll add CMK note to the listing copy: "Customers may supply a customer-managed key for image encryption; admin approval required."

Erin: Great. Next actions: Kofi share SKU mapping doc; Mei push manifest and CI links; Samantha attach EULA snippet to package. Quick sync tomorrow 9am PT. Post blockers here. :white_check_mark:
